meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did he find out from the gradebook on his phone in the middle of class?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
Which night, Hale? I'm writing down 612 words at 11:52 PM, but I want to see the page myself, not hear it described. And you still haven't told me why nobody called me before that zero went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." I'm not here to be made happy, Hale. If the zero is coming off, I want that in writing today, and I still want to know why nobody called me first.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: the principal

Hale,

You said you would remove the zero, and nothing else was agreed. I still want that confirmed in writing, along with an explanation of why nobody called me before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with you offering to remove the zero but nothing confirmed, and she still wants it in writing plus an answer on why no one called first.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because you backed away from your own evidence before she had even seen it.
Try next time: when she asked which night, give her the date and show the version history page instead of giving up the zero.
